subject: biology-9
chapterTitle: Unit 04: Cell Cycle: Mitosis, Meiosis & Cell Division
description: Phases of the cell cycle (Interphase G1, S, G2), mitosis (karyokinesis & cytokinesis), meiosis I and II, crossing over, significance of division, and apoptosis.

questions.question: During which phase does a cell grow and prepare for DNA replication?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option A ('G1 phase') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: If a cell skips the S phase, what will happen in mitosis?

options.B: It will have half the required DNA

questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('It will have half the required DNA') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: Which phase of the cell cycle is the shortest?
questions.explanation: Spindle Apparatus

questions.question: The spindle fibers attach to chromosomes at the:
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('Kinetochore') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: If spindle fibers do not form, what will happen?

options.C: The nuclear membrane will not break

questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('Chromosomes will not separate properly') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: In animal cells, spindle fibers originate from:
questions.explanation: Mitosis

questions.question: At which stage do chromosomes align at the center of the cell?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('Metaphase') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: If a cell completes mitosis but not cytokinesis, what will be the result?

options.A: A single cell with two nuclei
options.C: A cell with half the chromosomes

questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option A ('A single cell with two nuclei') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: What disappears during prophase?
questions.explanation: Significance of Mitosis

questions.question: Mitosis ensures:

options.B: Exact copy of the parent cell

questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('Exact copy of the parent cell') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: The replacement of old and damaged cells happens due to:
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option A ('Mitosis') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of mitosis?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option A ('Healing of a cut') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: Which body part shows the highest rate of mitosis?
questions.explanation: Asexual Reproduction

questions.question: Which type of asexual reproduction occurs in yeast?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('Budding') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: Why does asexual reproduction produce identical offspring?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('No DNA mixing occurs') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: Tissue culture is used to:

options.A: Grow plants from a few cells

questions.explanation: Meiosis

questions.question: How many cells are produced at the end of meiosis?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('4') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: What happens in Anaphase I of meiosis?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('Homologous chromosomes separate') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: If a cell has 10 chromosomes before meiosis, how many will each daughter cell have after meiosis?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('5') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: When does crossing over occur?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option A ('Prophase I') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: Why is the second division in meiosis necessary?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option C ('To separate sister chromatids') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: If an error occurs in meiosis and chromosomes do not separate, what could happen?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option A ('A genetic disorder') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: Which phase of meiosis is most similar to mitosis?
questions.explanation: Significance of Meiosis

questions.question: Why is meiosis important for sexual reproduction?

options.A: It maintains chromosome number in offspring

questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option A ('It maintains chromosome number in offspring') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: What is the main outcome of meiosis?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option C ('Genetic diversity') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: The main difference between mitosis and meiosis is:
questions.explanation: Genetic Variation

questions.question: What process in meiosis increases genetic variation?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('Crossing over') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: If independent assortment did not happen, what would be the result?

options.A: All offspring would be genetically identical
options.B: Cells would have twice the DNA

questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option A ('All offspring would be genetically identical') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: How does meiosis create variation in a species?

options.A: By ensuring all offspring are identical

questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('By allowing genes to shuffle') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: Why does sexual reproduction result in more variation than asexual reproduction?

options.A: It allows DNA from two parents

questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option A ('It allows DNA from two parents') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: If a mistake occurs during meiosis, what might be affected?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('Chromosome number in offspring') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: Which event in meiosis leads to different combinations of traits?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('Independent assortment') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: Why are siblings not identical?

options.B: All cells divide at different rates

questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option A ('Meiosis and fertilization shuffle genes') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: Which of these would decrease genetic variation?
questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option A ('Asexual reproduction') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.

questions.question: What best describes the role of random fertilization?

options.A: It ensures only the strongest sperm fertilizes the egg
options.B: It increases variation by combining different gametes

questions.explanation: According to FBISE Class 9 Biology curriculum standards, Option B ('It increases variation by combining different gametes') is the correct biological fact for Cell Cycle.
